cluster_thesis.text: The 800G->1.6T transition is barely started and is supply-constrained at the laser, not at the module. Both LITE and COHR are shipping 1.6T today and COHR calls its ramp faster than it expected three months ago; NVDA is investing directly into laser/photonics capacity rather than module capacity. That is an early-innings, capacity-led upcycle, and it is a different clock from memory contract pricing, which is late in the HBM3E basis. The 2026-09-14 drawdown in this cluster was a financing-structure scare (GLW ATM) plus the Amodei pacing-essay sentiment shock, both of which the catalyst desk has since WEAKENED to unresolved-but-unescalated and sentiment-only respectively; Friday 09-18 (COHR +5%, LITE +3%, GLW +3%) recovered part of it against an unchanged order book.
cluster_thesis.falsifier: A hyperscaler or NVDA disclosing a 1.6T module order cut or a laser-capacity build pause; OR LITE/COHR reporting 200G/lane EML lead times SHORTENING materially into the Nov-2026 prints, which would say the binding constraint has cleared and the pricing power with it.

redundant_pairs.same_bet_because: Same binding component (200G/lane EML into 1.6T sockets), same end customers, same NVDA supply relationship, and they moved together through both legs of the September event -- -9%/-11% on the 09-14 GLW ATM contagion and +3%/+5% on the 09-18 rebound. No return series is cached so this is a business-grounds verdict, not a measured correlation.

Both monetise custom-ASIC attach at the same hyperscalers, but MRVL sells the accelerator/DSP silicon and ALAB the scale-up connectivity around it -- different content per rack, different competitors, and they can diverge on a single customer's architecture choice.

Labelled together as optics and they trade together on sector shocks, but active laser economics and passive fiber/glass economics are on opposite sides of the margin migration. GLW is a conviction question, not an overlap question.
Connector versus systems -- no shared component, no shared customer structure, no shared margin pool. Listed only to record that the 7 line items contain exactly one redundancy, not several.
